blocks.html: In Group R-2 and R-3 occupancies, where there are four or more dwelling units within a single structure, on a single site where multiple buildings containing Type A, Type B+NYC units or Type B units are served by common recreational facilities, 25 percent, but not less than one, of each type of recreational facility serving each building shall be accessible. The total number of each type of recreational facility that is required to be accessible shall be determined by considering every recreational facility of each type serving each building on the site.
